title: feat(app-shell): the left sidebar resizes by its edge and floats as a card; a menu opened from the float keeps it out
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Q1S7wY1gUVUGBELhQFqBHt)_

Fixes #36227
Fixes #36471
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：电脑上左侧栏钉住时，拖右边缘可以调宽（200 到 350），双击回到默认宽度，刷新后宽度还在；侧栏收起后从屏幕最左边浮出来时，变成四周留边、圆角、带阴影的卡片，宽度和钉住时一样；从浮出的侧栏点应用名，菜单完整显示，侧栏不再缩回去把菜单切掉。
- 为什么做：外壳专题里「左侧栏照 Attio 改」这一张，加上验收时发现的应用菜单被切掉的缺陷。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是侧栏宽度或浮出样式不对、浮出的侧栏收回时机不对，菜单和页面内容都不受影响；可以直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Resize (#36227)** — `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/SidebarWidthHandle.tsx` (new), `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `consoleSidebarRail.ts`
- From 768 px up, the docked sidebar's right edge is a `role="separator"` handle: a pointer drag resizes it between 200 and 350 px (Attio's range, the card's numbers), a double-click comes back to 256 (unchanged default), ← → move it 16 px, Home / End go to either end.
- The width is a per-browser reader preference, `console.sidebar.width` (`CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_WIDTH_PREFERENCE`, stored `{"width":N,"v":1}`, read back clamped to the range). Kept on drag end, not mid-drag.
- The width reaches the primitive by setting `--sidebar-width` on the console's `display: contents` frame around the sidebar, so the in-flow gap, the docked panel and the float all take it. While a drag runs the frame turns off the primitive's width transition so the panel follows the pointer. The phone drawer is untouched (it sets its own width), and so is `@object-ui/components`.
- The float has no handle: the card asks for a resizable docked sidebar only.

**The float is a card (#36227 items 2–4)** — `RAIL_OVERLAY_PANEL`, `RAIL_HIDDEN_PANEL` in `consoleSidebarRail.ts`
- Floating over the collapsed sidebar, the panel is a card 8 px off the window's left, top and bottom edges, with `rounded-lg`, a border and `shadow-xl`. Nothing dims or moves the page under it (no backdrop, the gap stays at 0).
- Hidden, the panel keeps the card's shape and is parked its width plus 2 rem past the edge, so the shadow does not show at the window edge and the card does not change shape while it slides.
- Item 3 (rest on the left edge floats it, moving off it folds it, a press on the expand button docks it) was already on `main` (#35062 / #36112). Unchanged except as below.

**A menu opened from the float keeps it out (#36471)** — `useConsoleSidebarRailPanel`
- Root cause, reproduced in a browser on this branch's base: the pointer moves onto the app name while the float is still sliding in, so for a moment it is past the panel's edge. That starts the 150 ms "pointer away" clock. The press on the app name opens the menu, but the clock was never stopped: it fires and folds the float, and the menu stays anchored to a trigger now off-screen (the card's second screenshot). The timer only checked "is a menu open" on later pointer moves, never when it fired.
- Fix: a press in the float (the app name, the account, an entry's `…`, an entry) stops the clock; and when the clock fires it folds only if no menu or dialog is open and the pointer is not on the float. "On the float" includes the 8 px margin the card now keeps from the window edge, where the pointer that floated it rests.
- After the menu closes (Esc, or a choice), the float folds by the usual rules: a move away, a navigation, a press outside.
- Card item 2 (the account menu, the notification panel, an entry's `…`): the same press path, so the same fix. The account menu and an entry's `…` were checked in the browser (screenshots 6 and 7).

**i18n** — `sidebar.resize` ("Resize sidebar", the handle's accessible name) in all 11 locales.

## Tests

- `UnifiedSidebar.hiddenCollapse-35062.test.tsx` (the shared harness, two new top-level `describe`s, 10 tests):
  - #36227: drag clamps at 350 and 200, the frame turns its transition off mid-drag and keeps nothing until the drag ends, the width is kept and a reload reads it; double-click returns 256; End / ArrowRight / ArrowLeft / Home; an out-of-range kept width reads as the nearest end; the handle unmounting mid-drag (⌘B, then a narrow window) ends the drag as a cancel, restoring the body's `user-select` / `cursor` and the width; collapsed there is no handle, the float takes the kept width with the card classes and the hidden panel the parked card; a phone sets no width.
  - #36471: the app name pressed while the fold's clock runs opens the menu and the float stays past 3× the delay; a menu opened from the float by the keyboard (no press) holds it too; a press in the float stops the clock and a later move away folds it; once the menu closes, moving away folds it.
- Run at `eb24661e2` (from `ui/`, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/`): **Test Files 155 passed (155), Tests 1276 passed (1276)**. `tsc --noEmit` of `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0; eslint on the changed files: clean. At `eebb75006` the 30 `dispatch-gates --commands` families ran locally, all exit 0.
- Ablation (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob each time): removing both halves of the #36471 fix turns the three press/keyboard tests red; removing only the press half turns "a press in the float stops the fold's clock" red; removing only the fire-time check turns the keyboard test red. Each half is pinned by its own test. Dropping the handle's unmount cleanup turns the mid-drag test red.
- `consoleSidebarRail.width-27593.test.tsx`: comment only (the 256 it pins is now the default, not a fixed width).

## Acceptance notes

- The sidebar's background is the theme's translucent `bg-sidebar` with a backdrop blur (pre-existing). Over page content the card shows a blurred hint of what is under it near its edge (visible in screenshot 3). Attio's card is opaque; not changed here.
- On a touch screen nothing new: the float still opens by the expand button or a press on the edge, the handle takes a drag.
- The card's "what width folds automatically" stays out of scope, as the card says.

## Verification

Read first, by risk: `consoleSidebarRail.ts` (the fold timer and `pointerOnFloat`), `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` (the frame's `--sidebar-width`), `SidebarWidthHandle.tsx`.

Two-minute check: at 1440 wide, drag the sidebar's right edge right, then double-click it; collapse with the sidebar's button, rest the mouse on the window's left edge, and as the card slides in click the app name: the app menu shows whole and the sidebar stays until you press Esc and move away.
